name: Concentrix
tagline: We design, build, and run integrated human + AI operations inside the world's most complex enterprises.
description: Concentrix is a global business process outsourcing and customer experience company serving Fortune Global 500 clients across more than 70 countries. Founded as a SYNNEX business unit in 2006, it spun off as an independent public company in 2020 and trades on Nasdaq under CNXC. The company blends digital operations, enterprise technology, data analytics, and strategy consulting to manage billions of human and AI interactions annually.

faqs.question: What industries does Concentrix serve?
faqs.answer: Concentrix serves clients across technology, financial services, retail, healthcare, communications, media, and public sector industries worldwide.

faqs.question: Where is Concentrix headquartered?
faqs.answer: Concentrix is headquartered in Newark, California, with operations in more than 70 countries across six continents.

faqs.question: What services does Concentrix provide?
faqs.answer: Concentrix provides customer experience management, digital operations (sales, marketing, customer service, finance and compliance), enterprise technology, data and analytics, and strategy and design services.

faqs.question: Is Concentrix a publicly traded company?
faqs.answer: Yes. Concentrix trades on the Nasdaq exchange under the ticker symbol CNXC and is ranked #426 on the Fortune 500 (2025).

faqs.question: How large is Concentrix?
faqs.answer: Concentrix employs approximately 290,000 to 455,000 people globally, depending on the reporting period, and operates roughly 270 locations worldwide.

clients_summary: Concentrix serves more than 2,000 clients globally, primarily Fortune 500 and Global 500 enterprises across multiple verticals.

faqs.answer: DOOR3 offers technology consulting (discovery, CTO/CIO advisory, digital strategy), UX/UI design, custom software and web/mobile development, project rescue, and AI/agentic AI services.

faqs.answer: DOOR3 is headquartered in New York City (370 Lexington Ave.) with additional offices in Barcelona, Spain, and Kyiv, Ukraine.

faqs.answer: DOOR3 works with clients ranging from startups and mid-market companies to Fortune 500 enterprises, serving diverse industries including finance, healthcare, and retail.

faqs.answer: DOOR3 has been named a Game-Changing Software Developer in NYC by Clutch and has appeared on the Clutch 1000 list of top global service providers.

name: Trio
tagline: Code that moves money. Talent that moves fast - nearshore software engineering for fintech.
description: Trio is a nearshore software engineering company founded in 2019, headquartered in Sao Paulo, Brazil, with founding roots in Boston, Massachusetts. faqs.answer: Trio focuses exclusively on nearshore talent from Latin America and Africa, ensuring developers work in US timezones and integrate seamlessly into existing client teams.

faqs.question: What industries does Trio serve?
faqs.answer: Trio primarily serves fintech companies - including payments, open banking, lending, neobanks, core banking, RegTech, and fraud detection - and high-growth technology companies.

faqs.question: Where are Trio's developers located?
faqs.answer: Trio sources engineers from Latin America (primarily Brazil and nearby countries) and Africa, all working in US-compatible timezones for seamless collaboration.

faqs.question: What is Trio's customer retention rate?
faqs.answer: Trio maintains a 90% customer retention rate, reflecting the continuity and trust-based approach the company emphasizes over transactional outsourcing.

clients_summary: Trio has served fintech and high-growth technology companies including Everyday Speech, helping them build and scale engineering teams with nearshore talent.
